integrity: Explicit proof and a standalone reproducible finite checker are supplied. The finite checks are corroboration, not a proof of the quantified theorem. Publication priority is provisional; no independent mathematical validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem applies only to complex Hermitian 2-by-2 matrices with equal trace in the spectral operator norm, not arbitrary matrix absolute values, other dimensions, or other norms. The nonzero-trace sharp bound is not attained by distinct pairs.
title: Trace-slice discontinuity in the sharp spectral Lipschitz modulus of two-level matrix absolute value
